GTA 6's Box Has No Disc: What You're Actually Buying (212 GB + Pre-Load Times) 📦

video // Nov 6, 2026

Watch on YouTube

Hold up. If GTA 6 is a download either way, what am I buying the box for? 📦

Grand Theft Auto VI comes out November 19. Rockstar says the boxed version holds a download code, with no disc inside. Sony told PS5 players to clear at least 212 GB of free space. In this XFD Blue episode, OC breaks down what that means for launch night.

Watch the Short

The quick version, in 35 seconds:

Sony and Rockstar said two different things

Sony describes the free space to prepare on PS5: at least 212 GB. Rockstar says the pre-load file is "up to 212 GB depending on your device." Neither promises every console downloads exactly the same amount. Xbox players should check the requirement on their own console instead of using Sony's PS5 number.

How much space you really have

The number on the box (1 TB or whatever) is the whole drive, and the system keeps part of it. Reviewers measured roughly 667 GB of usable space on a launch PS5 and about 840 GB on the 1 TB Slim. So 212 GB is about a third of a launch PS5 and about a quarter of a Slim, for one game. Your real number depends on what's already installed, so go look at yours, and leave some breathing room beyond the minimum.

When pre-load starts

  • **PS5:** Tuesday, November 10, at midnight your local time.
  • **Xbox:** midnight GMT on November 10. In the U.S. that's Monday, November 9, at 7 p.m. Eastern, 6 Central, 5 Mountain and 4 Pacific.

The PS5 pre-order catch

Sony says PS5 pre-download is for people who pre-order. If you decide on launch day, you start from zero on the 19th. The box's code supports pre-load, but boxes hit stores November 12, two days after pre-load opens.

What's actually in the box

A code you redeem for the digital download. No disc. That's on Rockstar's own support page, not a rumor or a leak. For a lot of us, buying the box used to be buying the game. Now it's more like a receipt you can put on a shelf. And it's not just GTA: Sony already announced that starting January 2028, no discs get made for new PlayStation games.

Who should buy what

  • **Collectors:** if the shelf matters to you, the box still gives you that. No shade.
  • **Play-at-midnight people:** the box shows up on the 12th, and PS5 pre-download needs a pre-order.
  • **Gift givers:** a box is still something you can wrap.
  • **Trade-in people:** ask your store what they'll do with a code-in-box before you buy.

7-step launch checklist

1. Check your free space this week. On PS5, Sony says clear at least 212 GB.
2. Back up your saves before you delete anything, using your console's official steps.
3. Adding storage? Make sure it's compatible with your exact console first.
4. On PS5, pre-download needs a pre-order.
5. Know your start time and set a reminder.
6. Buying the box? It's in stores the 12th, and the code supports pre-load.
7. Do all this on a calm weeknight, not at 11:58 on launch night.

Quick answers

Does GTA 6 come on a disc? No. Rockstar says the boxed version contains a download code.

How much space does GTA 6 need? Sony says clear at least 212 GB on PS5. Rockstar says the pre-load is up to 212 GB depending on your device.

When does GTA 6 pre-load start? November 10: midnight local time on PS5, midnight GMT on Xbox (7 p.m. Eastern on November 9 in the U.S.).

When does GTA 6 come out? November 19, 2026. Boxed copies reach stores November 12.

Sources (from the video): PlayStation Blog, Rockstar Support (Platforms, Editions and Versions; Pre-Load FAQ), Rockstar Newswire and PlayStation Support.

Box at launch, or digital all the way? One word.
